term: modal causal opportunity for a beginning of contingent concrete reality
definition: In analyst-defined Scenario World Being, PossiblyBeginsAt s w asserts accessibility of some complete history satisfying the supplied, unconstrained beginning predicate beginsContingency (BEGINS_3, a schematic placeholder fixing no sense of beginning) and containing at least one existent contingent concrete individual. CausalOpportunityAt s w asserts that if this is possible, an accessible history satisfying the predicate contains an existing concrete individual outside all contingent concreta there that stands in the supplied totality-cause relation causesContingencyTotality. That relation is an unconstrained parameter, separate from efficient causation of each member; nothing in the type makes it causal. Unlike an unrestricted PSR, actual beginnings need not be caused. The possibility and adequacy of the premise remain independent metaphysical obligations.
note: Analyst's comparison for #505 and #492 (A3–A7). Not an attributed reconstruction of Pruss, Rasmussen, or necessarybeing.com until primary source has been pinned, materialized, read, and interpretively audited. Neither global S5 applicability nor the possibility of the first joint beginning is assumed within the definition.
